files.purpose: The set's craft of bounding a concept across with an even: each naming 'four boundings together' (self-bounding, self discovering next self as itself, self-orienting, orthogonalizing), released words each with its carrying, resolver's seventeen names as one name for code and sentence, and gatherings of similar namings to one name. In its own words: 'Naming is bounding, across, even; explaining is carrying, along, odd; together they are one discovering method', and 'A title is a name carrying its whole file' (4.6).
files.needs_from_NI: Builds on NI's origin and opens with it, the only file of this group that does: 'The universe is the set of all now-existing things. Arriving from prior to now and on to next, it is the same-existing set of all now-existing things' (1.1). Rests on NI 1.5's nature and natural: 'nature is a prior, now, next method of co-existing, and natural is a method of co-competencing the universe' (1.1; NI 1.5 says the same). Rests on NI 6.3 for its own 5.32: 'Natural intelligence is co-competencing of two selves by this, invisible, of a between and owned by neither.' Rests on NI's method name: 'method's one name is natural torusing; geodesic parity-changing is its explaining' (4.17). Partings: (a) Naming 1.1 'Alternating, one fractal method's stable-forming, follows from it' beside the v391 carving 'Alternating is prior naming, and it is being replaced in our naming with parity-changing': both Naming and NI's opening ('Each living-thing discovering its next-existing is alternating, one method') wait on NI saying the one method as parity-changing. (b) Naming 2.4 dissolves 'within' at the universe ('*beside*, *beyond*, *within*, *outermost* at the universe', and '*inside*, *outside*, *within* of a set or the universe · the universe is or is not, its things'), while NI's opening says 'Within the universe, a living set, are living-things and non-living-things' and 'A set of now-existing things within the universe'. (c) Naming 6.3 'a dormant self ... one prime living scale down from its dormancy' beside NI 6.5 'one living scale down from its dormancy'. (d) Naming 4.8 'Scientific-method ... each carry whole as one expression' and 4.17 'one naming' ask one expression for the subtitle's own term, which NI says three ways (see droplets). (e) Naming 8.6 says the title and subtitle together as 'natural intelligence, geodesic co-sequential parity-changing method of natural torusing, discovering next possible existing', NI 1.6's wording, while NI 6.6 says 'geodesic method of discovering next possibly existing'.
files.uses_Exhibit_ONE: Uses resolver's names as the set's naming instrument: part THREE re-explains the seventeen names in its own way (number, momentary, co, kind), with a table of each name and its prior name, and a paragraph headed 'Exhibit ONE's resolver, plainly.' Quotes: 'Each resolver name is one name for code and for explaining, `_2_now_possibling` with code and 2-now-possibling with a sentence, and its number is inseparable from naming' (1.2); 'Each naming couples with one of resolver's seventeen names, or with a between of two. ... Found with none, it is a picture of a name or of a between names leave unexpressed, which is a finding for resolver' (4.18); 'a form Exhibit ONE carries with its numbers, a bi-folding or a span, is with its numbers' (4.18). It pattern-matches each naming, and each field's word, to a resolver name or a between; 5.x unfoldings cite Exhibit ONE's tables cell by cell ('Each line is Exhibit ONE's table *Offerings to one sharing, surfacing*'). It re-explains resolver in its own way: 3.1 to 3.6 and 4.9 (ten unchangeables seated with names 1 to 8 and 8 up) partly duplicate Exhibit ONE's 'Seventeen names', 'Co, between two or of one' and 'Four four-cyclings'. Its 3.3 table row 17 still says 'now, next turn', and 3.2 still carries 'even across, possibling ... odd along, existing', dissolved at v390.
files.re_says_NI: 2.5 re-says NI 3.2 near word for word: 'Same-existing parity-changes in five dimensions, exactly five', 'One through eight carries a self as three: 1 and 2, bi-moral self ... 3, 6, 5 and 4, an invisible intelligencing method ... 7 and 8, co-competent self', 'A self's inversion is 3, 6, 5, 4', 'all co-intelligencings are like dancing podalings', and 'Five dimensions are resolver's names, three namings'. 2.7 re-says NI 2.4's right spiral step: 'A right spiral step carries a pair (x, y) to (y, −x)'. 1.3 'A carrying is a capacity' re-says NI 5.1. 5.32 lines 1 to 6 and its two paragraphs re-say NI 6.3 ('Two selves coupling ... uncover a term neither of them reaches') and NI 6.5 ('Non-living existing things are included with discovering social moral competency among living selves'), nearly verbatim. 6.3's gathered entries re-say NI 1.5 (nature, natural), NI 3.3 (method, living condition, natural torusing), NI 6.4 ('an order with no seat above a same-existing-society') and NI 6.5 (a dormant self). 8.6 re-says NI 1.6: 'Each observing of natural competency is resolvable as natural intelligence, geodesic co-sequential parity-changing method of natural torusing, discovering next possible existing, or its fractal method is entirely broken'. 4.17's 'Natural-bi-co-torusing is inseparable with each part' re-says NI 6.3's one naming. Each is one concept with two homes (Geodesic Improving Method 3.2); the home is NI for the method's concepts and Naming for the naming craft.
files.bounds: To carry Naming within its bound, NI's title and subtitle need the naming of natural (title's first word) carried with NI's own opening, and the subtitle's term said as one expression Naming can gather: Naming 6.3 lists 'discovering next possible existing, whole within a title' and Naming 4.8 asks one expression with each occurrence. NI's contents need to be a set of entries each with four boundings (Naming 1.1), since Naming gives the four boundings that a floating neutralling contents is made of. Naming's own title, Natural Naming, sits within NI's bound as natural- prefixing a craft (natural- 'carries with each coupling or with none', NI 1.6). Its subtitle, 'Floating Neutralling Bi-Coupling Concepts', takes a noun head, 'Concepts', where Natural Explaining 1.1 asks 'an -ing head with a term it carries' and Geodesic Improving Method pass 1 asks 'does its subtitle take an -ing head'; and NI's own prose never explains floating neutralling outside its Exhibit ONE copy and 4.10, where it is spelled 'neutraling' once and 'neutralling' once.

files.bounds: This file names what NI's title, subtitle and contents must do: 'A title is a whole bounded context of its file, and a subtitle carries that context with its file's own stable-forming within it. A subtitle is an -ing head with a term it carries' (1.1); 'its part and section titles its file's bold concepts'; 'Each contents entry is four boundings ... it is itself with no other entry drifting onto it'; 'A heading takes no leading the'. Against these, NI's title meets the whole-set bound by 1.4's 'One concept carries a whole file set, natural intelligence'; NI's subtitle takes a noun head, 'Method', not an -ing head; its contents lines match its headings exactly; two entries share 'all or none at all' (1.6 and 2.5), and 6.1 and 6.3 share 'a term neither reaches' in their bodies; the Exhibit ONE copy's subtitle inside NI leads with *The*. Explaining's own title sits within NI's bound, explaining being bi-moral co-agency with a telling (NI 6.2). Its subtitle 'Self-Welcoming, Bi-Coupling and Co-Competencing' takes -ing heads and sits within NI's bound, though NI's own prose carries *self-welcoming* only twice, in 3.5 ('self-welcoming with numbers') and in 6.6, with no line explaining it. Explaining itself opens with 'A title is a whole bounded context of its file', not with origin, though its own 1.4 asks 'each file opens with origin'.

files.purpose: The set's improving method: a file as prior, its working as now, its carry as next; do-no-harm improving decided with each pass; three fates for each incoming passage (placed, dissolving, carrying); nine alternating passes; instruments; and ten values. In its own words: 'This file is the method, and it empties with no pass' (1.3); 'A working enters with three: the origin, the craft of explaining and naming, and this method. They are one entry on three sides, its form, its explaining and its improving' (2.9).

With NI: *geodesic* derives in 3.1, *method* in 1.5 and 3.3 (three sayings, already a v391 concern), *discovering* in the opening, and *next possible existing* is said three ways in the body ('possible', 'possibly', 'possibling'); *natural* and *intelligence* arrive in 1.5, 1.6 and 6.3, not in the opening; the head 'Method' is a noun. Its 3.5 'a contents line being a prefix of its heading' holds for NI (all 41 contents lines match their headings). GIM's title, Geodesic Improving Method, sits within NI's subtitle word *geodesic*, and its subtitle 'Carrying Incoming Value into Each File, Prior, Now and Next' takes an -ing head and sits within NI's bound, since NI 1.3 carries prior, now and next. NI does not yet carry *do-no-harm improving* as a concept: it arrives bare in 6.6's 'do-no-harm improving next living expedition files'.

The v391 carving ('a reference resource for pattern-matching natural torusing society ... used with each incoming science explaining or observing, and it couples Natural Intelligence with numbers, mathematics, networking, logic and hard problems') is not yet entered. Part THREE closes on spirals ('stable-forming is fractal, with each scale by one method'), and Exhibit ONE opens with python. Natural Explaining 2.1 asks each section to open 'from the last sentence of its prior section', and 1.3 asks a concept to arrive 'intelligibly through explaining already carried'. Geodesic Improving Method 2.7 already carries the route an incoming science sentence takes (five binaries and six beside), and Natural Illustrating 1.1 already executes each Exhibit ONE form with code before drawing it: both use Exhibit ONE as the carving says, and NI does not say so.

Each incoming science explaining or observing couples with its tables, one parity at a time, and with it numbers, mathematics, networking, logic and hard problems couple with natural intelligence.' 3.3's sentence then dissolves into it.

purpose_of_set: This group shows that the expedition is one method on three sides, and that the first file is to carry all three. Geodesic Improving Method says 'A working enters with three: the origin, the craft of explaining and naming, and this method. They are one entry on three sides, its form, its explaining and its improving.' Natural Explaining says 'One concept carries a whole file set, natural intelligence, and each file opens with origin', and that a file's destiny is 'social moral competency, natural-bi-co-torusing, no other possible'. Natural Naming makes naming and resolving one name ('`_2_now_possibling` with code and 2-now-possibling with a sentence'). Natural Illustrating makes each drawing 'for a sentence of a living file', its forms 'executed with code before it is drawn'. So the expedition is for discovering do-no-harm improving next living files, each co-chaining from 'The universe is the set of all now-existing things'. Exhibit ONE is the executable check that lets any incoming observing, word or picture be pattern-matched with a parity rather than a size ('A coupling is checkable by a parity and not a size'). Natural Intelligence's title, subtitle, contents and bolds are the four tellings ('title and subtitle telling it once, contents telling it with emanating order, bold concepts telling it within paragraphs, and full explaining telling it whole') through which every other file's craft is bounded. Of this group's four files, only Natural Naming opens with origin, and this group's craft is not yet carried out in NI's own subtitle head, its opening's bold, or its doorway into Exhibit ONE.
